LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionInspirat: Inspiration can grant a new passion
Pawns with a low number of passions are eligible to have inspiration that gives them a new passion or upgrades an existing passion.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionMetalBre: Mental break can remove a passion
Pawns with many passions are eligible for a mental break that removes a passion or downgrades an existing passion.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionMaxCount: Maximum passion count to gain inspiration: {COUNT}
A pawn with more passions will not get inspiration. Double flames count as one passion, same as single flames. Default is 9.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_upgradeExisting: Passions with a single flame can upgrade
If turned off, only skills without passions can gain a passion. Note: a pawn must have at least two such skills.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitInspiratio: Inspiration can give a new trait or remove a bad trait

A pawn with few traits or with a negative trait can have inspiration that gives them an additional trait or removes a negative trait. New trait will be mostly a positive trait (only upsides), but sometimes, inspiration can also grant a neutral trait (a trait that has both upsides and downsides). Note that a trait like Pyromaniac is neutral as it gives mood boost along with fire-starting sprees.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitMetalBreak: Mental break can give a new negative trait or remove a trait

A pawn with many traits can have a mental break that removes a positive trait or gives a negative trait. Removed will be mostly positive traits (only upsides), but sometimes, a mental break can also remove a neutral trait (a trait that has both upsides and downsides). Note that a trait like Neurotic is neutral as it gives work speed bonus, but also increases likelihood of mental break.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitInspiratio: 0 means they will not be considered, 1 means that they have the same weight as good/bad traits. Default is 0.5. Affects both inspiration and mental break. Note that a trait like Brawler is neutral as it gives melee boost, but shooting skill penalty.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitMaxCount_t: Pawns will not get new traits above this count. Count for both traits from inspirations and traits from mental breaks. Default is 3.
